footnote_text: On September 29, 2026, Mr. Kanayama acquired 1,396,755 ordinary shares ("Ordinary Shares") of Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. (the "Company") directly from the Company for JPY58,838,000 in aggregate, or approximately JPY42.124782 per share. The US$0.274 per-share pricing benchmark was converted at the JPY/US$ Telegraphic Transfer Middle Rate of 153.74 per US$1.00, published by Mitsubishi UFJ Research & Consulting Co., Ltd. on September 9, 2026, the business day before the approval of the board of directors of the Company.

On September 29, 2026, Tokushin (as defined below) acquired 12,106,893 Ordinary Shares by contributing its JPY510,000,000 loan principal receivable from the Company, equivalent to approximately JPY42.124763 per share (approximately US$0.274 per share using the same pricing benchmark and exchange rate in footnote 1). || Tokushin G. K. ("Tokushin") is a limited liability company formed under the laws of Japan owned by Mr. Kanayama and his family, for which Mr. Kanayama is the managing member, and accordingly, Mr. Kanayama has the voting and dispositive control of the ordinary shares Tokushin holds in the Company.

The reporting person has elected to receive fully vested shares of Deferred Stock Units ("DSUs") under the Issuer's 2020 Amended Omnibus Incentive Plan in lieu of cash fees payable for service on the Issuer's Board of Directors and any committees thereof. The reporting person made this election in 2025 which applies to the director's fees earned in 2026 in compliance with the issuer's black-out period guidelines. The number of shares represents the quotient of the amount of such fees divided by the issuer's closing stock price on the date such fees would otherwise be paid, rounded up to the nearest whole share. Such DSUs will be settled in shares of common stock ninety days following separation of service from the Board. The reporting person may elect a further deferral beyond the Settlement Date pursuant to the rules of Code Section 409A. || Amount represents 1,969 unvested DSUs and 16,712 vested DSUs.
